**Vault 1** is a location in the *Wastelad* holotape minigame.

The home of Wastelad, Vault 1 is the starting point of his quest to defeat Chairman Cheng. Inhabited by various patriotic residents, Wastelad can choose to bring up to 2 of them along on his quest.

Vault 1 appears in *Wastelad*.
